scope: Plain-language introductory summaries. Derived only from the already cited source material and the reviewed court-extract notes; not a live case-status check. Full source links remain in each article.

aldo-joseph-baccala.lead: Investor-fraud prosecution involving more than $17 million in losses reported by California DOJ.

aldo-joseph-baccala.sentence: DOJ reported a 20-year prison sentence. The $17 million-plus figure represents reported victim losses, not a verified restitution balance.
aldo-joseph-baccala.later: A complete court docket and any subsequent changes have not been independently checked.

timothy-charles-webb-jr.later: No later relief or amount actually repaid is verified.

jeffrey-holzworth.later: A resentencing petition was denied in 2015, followed by appellate affirmance entries in 2016–2017. This is separate from Karen Holzworth's record.

karen-holzworth.lead: A jury conviction was followed by probation and jail sentencing and a later post-conviction dismissal.
karen-holzworth.allegation: The prosecution concerned accessory and receiving-stolen-property offenses in the campus parking investigation.
karen-holzworth.disposition: The court record and appellate decision document convictions after a jury proceeding; her case is separate from Jeffrey Holzworth's.
karen-holzworth.sentence: In April 2015 the court imposed 36 months of formal probation and nine months of jail custody, not proof that all nine months were served.
karen-holzworth.later: On July 17, 2018, the court granted a Penal Code §1203.4 dismissal. It is not an acquittal.

constantine-petros.lead: Four insurance-related charges were dismissed, while one count produced a conviction that later received post-conviction dismissal.
constantine-petros.allegation: The five filed counts alleged conspiracy, insurance-claim misconduct, and grand theft. Filing charges was not a finding that each allegation was true.
constantine-petros.disposition: Four counts were dismissed in March 2017. A no-contest plea on the remaining insurance-claim count led to a conviction recorded in July 2017.
constantine-petros.sentence: Formal probation was imposed in 2017. The court record does not establish a jail or prison term for the dismissed counts.
constantine-petros.later: On September 17, 2020, the remaining count was reduced to a misdemeanor and dismissed under Penal Code §1203.4; probation was terminated. This was not an acquittal or a finding of factual innocence.
